name: Cafe Restaurant Edhof
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Café Restaurant Edhof in Tirol** Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, **Café Restaurant Edhof** invites you to savor the finest flavors of **Tirol** in a cozy, rustic setting. Whether you're seeking a hearty breakfast, a traditional **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a slice of homemade **Apfelstrudel**, our menu celebrates the region’s rich culinary heritage. Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, fluffy and caramelized, served with fresh berries or a dollop of **Vanillesauce**. For lunch, try our **Käsespätzle**—creamy egg noodles smothered in melted **Tiroler Bergkäse**—or a rustic **Wildschweinbraten** (wild boar roast) with **Krautsalat** and **Semmelknödel**. Afternoon coffee lovers will adore our **Melange** or **Einspänner**, paired with a selection of **Sachertorte** or **Topfenstrudel**. In the evening, unwind with a glass of **Tiroler Apfelwein** or a local **Bier** while enjoying our **Kartoffelsuppe** or a warm **Gulasch**. Located just outside **Innsbruck**, **Edhof** offers a peaceful retreat with panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. Whether you're passing through or exploring the **Zillertal** or **Ötztal**, our warm hospitality and authentic **Tiroler** cuisine make every visit unforgettable. **Come taste the soul of Tirol at Café Restaurant Edhof!** --- **Opening Hours:** - **Monday–Friday:** 7:30 AM – 9:00 PM - **Saturday–Sunday:** 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM *(Closed on select holidays—check our website for updates.)* **Reservations recommended:** 📞 **+43 (0)512 123456** 📍 **Edhof 7, 6080 Innsbruck-Langewies** --- **Visit our website** **Follow us on Facebook**
